strangerHistory.say: The Grey Tithe take a tenth of every hold. Overlook pays them nothing.
Three ports still stand. The rest are ruins, and nobody agrees how they fell.

tourSmiths.say: New face! Come here, let me guess your size.
The smiths. The sea kept your steel, so start with them.

tourWeaponsmith.say: Plain steel's cheap here, always. The good pieces come and go.

tourMage.say: The Mage opens Vestiges. Don't ask how.
Bring me anything sealed. We'll both be surprised by what's inside.

tourVault.say: The Vault. Anything you'd hate to lose, keep it there.
Nothing leaves my vault except in the hands that left it.

tourTailor.say: The Tailor. Colours, emblems, and opinions you didn't ask for.
Opinions are free. Looking like someone is not.

tourTack.say: The Tack has horses. Better than walking.
There's always a Bay in my stable, love. The rest don't stay long.

tourPost.say: Anything you drop on the road tends to end up with the Postmaster.
Letters too. I keep it all until you come for it.

tourHarbour.say: The harbour. Whatever your ship needs, the Harbourmaster knows who makes it.
Bring her in battered. She'll go out better than she came.

tourHall.say: The Hall of the Arts. Three houses, three chapels, and no two agree.

tourHallStorm.say: The Stormcallers. They keep the Storm, and never quietly.
Quiet never called a storm down. Come and see me.

tourHallVeiled.say: The Veiled keep the Shadow. Mind what you ask them.
We already know what you would ask.

tourHallLamps.say: And the Lamplighters keep the Divine. Hear all three before you choose.
Whoever you choose, child, our lamps stay lit for you.

strangerFarewell.say: Here. Four hundred Aurem. Spend it on steel first.
I wish you well. Stay out of the Tithe's books, if you can.
